timeline.text: Swim or gym day used to get its own tiny chip, crammed next to homework and real school events on our kitchen kiosk.
On a busy day, that chip for pack-your-kit just got buried.
Now the whole cell gets a thin colored frame instead, drawn with SVG.
The kit word loops endlessly around that frame's edge.
Homework keeps its space, and the one reminder that matters never disappears.
